A Chinese agronomist who developed the first hybrid rice varieties in the 1970s, and became known as the father of hybrid rice.

Yuan taught at a farm school in Hunan and lived through the great famine of 1959 to 1961, which drove him to work on raising yields. Rice pollinates itself, so crossing it on a large scale seemed impossible. In 1964 he began searching paddies for plants with sterile pollen. In 1970 his team found a wild male sterile rice on Hainan Island, and from it built a three line system to produce hybrid seed. Hybrid rice yielded about a fifth more than the best ordinary varieties.

From 1976 it spread across China, and soon covered about half its rice land, a key part of feeding a population of over a billion. His work is part of the wider Green Revolution, and he trained scientists from Asia and Africa. When he died in 2021, crowds lined the streets of Changsha.
sum: A Chinese agronomist who developed the first hybrid rice varieties in the 1970s, and became known as the father of hybrid rice.
